My open letter to @realDonaldTrump and @SecMullinDHS on the Big Bend border wall:

Dear President Trump,

I’m writing today with a simple plea: Please do not hand over the Rio Grande River to Mexico.

When I was 14 years old, I traveled to the Big Bend region of West Texas for the first time. As a suburban kid from Philadelphia, I’d never seen anything quite like it.

Counties nearly the size of New Jersey held no more than a couple thousand permanent residents. Mountains, rivers, desert arroyos
